name: BMW i4 M50
description: The BMW i4 M50 is an all-electric Gran Coupé that delivers M performance with zero emissions. It combines instant torque, a sleek design, and a luxurious interior.

reviews.name: Max R.
reviews.text: Amazing acceleration and premium feel. Silent but deadly fast!

reviews.name: Anna P.
reviews.text: Feels like driving the future. Stunning design and great range.

name: BMW i7 xDrive60
description: The BMW i7 xDrive60 redefines electric luxury with its unmatched comfort, advanced technology, and smooth power delivery.

reviews.name: Dmytro L.
reviews.text: Ultimate comfort. You don’t hear or feel the road — it’s pure luxury.

reviews.name: Olha T.
reviews.text: The interior is breathtaking and the tech is next level.

name: BMW iX M60
description: The BMW iX M60 combines M-level performance with electric innovation. Powerful, spacious, and designed for the modern driver.

reviews.name: Serhii B.
reviews.text: Insane torque! Feels like a spaceship on wheels.

reviews.name: Iryna V.
reviews.text: Luxury SUV with performance that beats many sports cars.

name: BMW iX1 xDrive30
description: The BMW iX1 xDrive30 brings electric driving to the compact SUV class — efficient, agile, and ideal for everyday adventures.

reviews.name: Ivan K.
reviews.text: Perfect size and great efficiency. Great daily electric SUV.

reviews.name: Kateryna D.
reviews.text: Compact but powerful — a joy to drive in the city!

name: BMW i5 M60 xDrive
description: The BMW i5 M60 xDrive delivers M performance with electric precision. A perfect balance of sportiness, innovation, and business-class comfort.

reviews.name: Yaroslav P.
reviews.text: Feels like an M5 but electric. Smooth, fast, and elegant.

name: BMW iX2 xDrive30
description: The BMW iX2 xDrive30 is a stylish electric crossover that merges coupe design with practicality and intelligent electric power.

reviews.name: Ostap M.
reviews.text: Stylish and fun to drive. Great visibility and features.

reviews.name: Viktoriia R.
reviews.text: Sporty design and solid range — love it!

description: The BMW i Vision Dee is a futuristic concept showcasing digital emotion, mixed-reality displays, and cutting-edge electric performance.

reviews.name: Taras H.
reviews.text: A glimpse into the future — absolutely stunning!

reviews.name: Nina S.
reviews.text: Futuristic design and amazing innovations from BMW.
